title: A remote erase this phone cannot read keeps the reminders opt-in and first-seen files until a good read
evidence: Partial 2026-11-14 (Options B+H, owner-approved): shape (a) and every landed remote erase are done; shapes (b) and (c) stay open as lead H129. A landed record whose erase moved now moves the store's erase count (RecordStore.land, Mark.erased(by:)), so ReminderScheduler's .erased ends the opt-in and the first-seen days even when the reminders read fails. Shape (a), a same-session view whose erase moved that the engine cannot draw, is now held undrawn (draw(_ view:), AC16f) instead of leaving the pre-erase record shown and scheduling from it. Open: (b) a cloud file the session refuses (cloud.ts ~:360-363) and (c) a relaunch on an erased record that will not draw: Swift never learns the erase identity; an engine door is needed (H129). US-25 AC16j, AC12b. Tests: RemoteEraseTakenInTests testARemoteEraseTheEngineCannotDrawIsHeld_S63, testARemoteEraseEndsRemindersWhenTheReadFails_S63, testAnUndrawnEditIsNotAnErase_S63. Was: ReminderScheduler ends reminders on a moved erase epoch (a good read) or a moved store erase count (ReminderEvent.erased, PR 1666). The count moves only on this phone's own erase: RecordStore.swift:316 (erasePhone) and :336 (showErased), and showErased is called only from CloudSync.swift:212, inside this phone's erase(). An erase made on another device arrives as a record with a higher epoch; if this phone cannot read it, reminders-opt-in and reminders-first-seen stay until a good read. Pending notifications are still removed on each refresh, since a failed read schedules none. Fix: move the erase count on news of a remote erase, even undrawn. Needs a design note first.
